static_traits.name: 林俊
static_traits.social_status: 有一群支持性的朋友与Mother作为支持系统；但在社交场合常感到被排斥与被误解，难以建立亲密关系
static_traits.medical_history: without显著躯体疾病；既往not yet接受心理治疗
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能自我Reflection并识do not思维偏差；配合度高、态度积极；首次来访略显Anxiety

basic_info.main_problem: 我认为在学校时因为我说最喜欢的科目是科学，孩子们就not喜欢我，由此产生Being rejected与孤立的感受；这种感受始于Student时期并延续至成年，影响自尊与社交，我在社交场合或尝试结交新朋友时常感到压力与被排斥。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这些Being rejected的感受正在影响我建立有意义关系的能力并影响我的心理健康。
growth_experiences: Student时期经历同伴的排斥与霸凌，因表达自己喜欢科学而被同学视为“not同”，由此Rising stress、产生Being rejected与孤立的感受，学业表现受到影响，这些经历延续至成年并持续影响自尊与人际互动。
家庭方面：Mother曾罹患癌症并康复，为家庭重要事件。

special_situations.event: Student时期公开表达自己最喜欢的科目是科学后，感到同学们都not喜欢自己
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的兴趣与多数人not同、暴露真实喜好，就会被排斥与讨厌
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries hard to cater to others, attempts to be more extroverted to seek recognition, or hides real interests in socializing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们not喜欢我，是因为我喜欢科学

special_situations.event: 上周参加朋友的聚会时收到正负混合信号（有人微笑打招呼，也有人对我投来异样目光），但我仍觉得not被欢迎并提前离开
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 负面线索比正面反馈更可信；如果not是所有人都热情，我就not被需要
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses attention on negative cues, reduces interaction and withdraws to avoid embarrassment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们not想我在这里，我not属于这里

special_situations.event: When trying to join a conversation, someone looks at me with a 'strange' look
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果他人的表情not够友好，就说明他们在嫌弃我或觉得我怪异
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding conversation and reducing self-exposure to protect oneself from evaluation

special_situations.event: In unfamiliar social settings or when trying to make new friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人have not立刻表现出明确的接纳，那他们最终not会喜欢我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Presumes negative outcomes and reduces proactive contact to avoid possible rejection and humiliation

core_conflict.wish: Desiring to be accepted, liked, and able to build meaningful intimate relationships
core_conflict.fear: Fears being rejected, humiliated, and excluded by peers again, worried that exposing the real self will bring harm
defense_goal: 通过保持疏离与减少自我暴露来避免Being rejected或尴尬
Withdraws socially to maintain self-esteem and a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: 被排斥的局外人、容易尴尬且not被需要的自己
object_relations.object_representation: Indifferent and critical groups/peers who may reject and mock at any time

manifestations: 在社交场合预设自己not被喜欢并撤退
Difficulty forming intimate relationships; often feels misunderstood

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Leaves parties early to avoid direct interaction
Reduces conversation and self-disclosure in social settings
When facing mixed signals, avoiding positive contact and focusing on negative cues

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Believes 'if I try to talk it will only make things worse or embarrass me'
Overly worries about others' evaluations before contacting people, limiting one's initiative

positive_force: 拥有支持性的朋友与Mother作为支持系统
Able to notice and name cognitive biases (such as noticing oneself focusing only on the negative)
Positive attitude, willing to try behavioral experiments and new perspectives
negative_force: In socializing, catastrophizes and overgeneralizes, tends toward mind reading and personalization
心理过滤导致忽视正面线索、ReinforcementBeing rejected感
Social avoidance与撤退，预设负面结果，降低互动机会
Impaired self-esteem、对他人评价高度敏感

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance与撤退（在社交场合减少对话、提前离场、避免自我暴露）
antecedent: Being in an unfamiliar social environment or trying to make new friends
参加聚会、试图加入谈话时
注意到他人not确定或略显负面的表情/反馈
target_behavior.core_reason: Student时期遭遇排斥与霸凌的经历内化为“I am not liked/会Being rejected”的核心信念，在当前社交中灾难化预测与读心术trigger强烈Anxiety与羞耻，进而选择撤退以Self-protection
target_behavior.function: Escapes potential rejection, humiliation, and embarrassment to protect self-esteem and security
target_behavior.consequence: 难以建立和维持亲密关系；Feels isolated与被误解；自尊进一步受损
